decision.observation: The goose stands in front of the closed gate; the latch bar's hooked end on the top rail near the right post is at ~(0.60, 0.48), slightly above standing beak height. A raised grassy bank/hummock lies just east of the right post at ~(0.70, 0.60).
decision.hypothesis: Standing on higher ground beside the post may raise the goose enough to reach the latch bar with its beak; then a grab could lift the latch out of its slot.
decision.memory: Latch design: bar hinged on left post, hooked end dropping into a slot on the right post; lifting/sliding it should free the gate.
